items.html: All politics is local. All successful movements are grassroots movements with real people struggling on their own grounds to bring change to their people. That is why, we encourage all Muslim community activists to look into possibilities of launching their own chapters that would shape the future hundreds and thousands of Muslm youth and their families.
items.text: All politics is local. All successful movements are grassroots movements with real people struggling on their own grounds to bring change to their people. That is why, we encourage all Muslim community activists to look into possibilities of launching their own chapters that would shape the future hundreds and thousands of Muslm youth and their families.

items.html:
Depending upon the level of a chapter,the range of benefits will differ. Some of the top benfits include: 

 

  • Locally incorporated

  • Shared national 501 C3 Status

  • Local control on money

  • All campaign material and support is provided by the national organization. (Chapter might need to pay for some cost.) 

  • Full strategic & tactical plans along with human support are provided to meet different goals.

  • Full support and publicity on social media

  • National speakers are arranged at lower costs.

  • One board member in the national board.

  • All coordinators/leaders are invited to our annual coordinator meeting where we discuss best practices, gain inspiration, and move the project forward.

items.html: TERMS & CONDITIONS

All Chapters are independent organizations bind with us through legal agreements. Some of the Terms and Conditions of our agreement include but are not limited to the following:

 

  • Incorporate within the local state

  • Share national 501 C3 Status

  • Open and maintain a bank account

  • Submit their annual financial report to the Treasurer of MYP-USA

  • Give 25% of their fundraising income to the national organization as a service fee.

  • Can apply for & receive local grants to meet their approved goals

  • Can have MYP-USA as national collaborator for any grant that might need a national partner as well.

  • Will abide by all rules of law regarding a 501 C 3 organization.

items.html: CHAPTERS LEVELS

START UP CHAPTER:

  • Meets our Goal # 1 

  • Produces and submits 4 youth videos 

  • Raises $1,000 startup funds

  • Holds one event per year with an attendence of a minimum of 100 people.

  • Conducts a Survey of at least 50 people.

 

BRONZE CHAPTER

  • Meets four goals of MYP USA including Goals # 1 & 2

  • Produces and submits 8 youth videos per year.

  • Holds two events a year with over 100 people each.

  • Reaches out to at least 1,000 people a year.

  • Conducts a survey of at least 200 people once a year.

  • Raise $5,000 or more to support the chapter.

 

SILVER CHAPTER

  • Meets six goals of MYP USA including Goals # 1, 2 & 3

  • Produces and submits 12 youth videos per year.

  • Holds four events a year with over 100 people each.

  • Reaches out to at least 2,000 people a year.

  • Conducts a survey of at least 500 people once a year.

  • Raises $10,000 or more to support the chapter.

 

GOLD CHAPTER

  • Meets 8 or more goals of MYP USA including Goals # 1 – 4.

  • Holds 6 events a year with over 100 people each.

  • Produces and submits 16 youth videos per year.

  • Reaches out to at least 5,000 people a year.

  • Conducts a survey of at least 1000 people once a year.

  • Raises $20,000 or more in revenue.

  • Runs a service project that’s supported via chapter and its volunteers
